protocol.name: LIV-01 event 2: third-plate STACK transfer overlaps the F.A.S.T. liquid leg (lanes)
protocol.description: Two-plate cycle with a real third-plate STACK transfer, spare A to spare B, during the F.A.S.T. liquid leg, and a serial return leg spare B to spare A after the out1 barrier. Mints one explicit step key per STACK transfer leg (-in1, -in2, -x1, -out1, -out2, -x2). Parameter names and values follow the GAL-02 template plus runbook rows 2a-2 and 3a-2 (store protocol 15 was not readable, see protocols/store-protocol-15.export.json). Spare nests have no default: the operator types the pair confirmed in 09-03. Physical arm motion beside a running liquid handler: runs only after its own typed GO (D-01, D-14).
